game_title: Stack Of Plates – Overgrown Archway Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway, a vine-choked archway: the rune scholar must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway: a vine-choked archway
core_gameplay_loop: In Overgrown Archway, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round, vine horrors strike the rune gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rune gate from vine horrors in Overgrown Archway: keep the stack_balance meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: stack_balance drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Overgrown Archway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while stack_balance > 0.
